value.title: DOCX → PDF vs Word's own export
Redlines vs Word's compare, opened in Word
value.note: Both groups are the release's samples, state-balanced; the full-corpus tables live in the bench's RESULTS.md.

value.d: Every reference PDF is exported by Microsoft Word and SHA-pinned. Redlines are opened in Word too: if Word refuses the file, the tool scores 0 for that pair.
Failures are not dropped. A crash, a timeout or an unopenable file counts as 0 in ITT mean and median, so a tool cannot improve its rank by skipping hard documents.
Ranks tie (n=) when the paired bootstrap interval of the median difference to the row above includes 0. 2,000 resamples, seed 42.
From 0.11.3 the tables on this page are the release's two samples — state-balanced, every file sha256-listed in the engine's release_info/. Full-corpus runs remain in the bench's RESULTS.md.
jubarte is marked † everywhere. Pins, run dates and sample lists are published so any row can be re-run; the harness is public.
